title: Did Madeira Hunt Whales? The Story of Caniçal's Whalers
description: Yes. Madeira hunted sperm whales from 1941 to 1981, in the end from a factory at Caniçal. How the whalers worked, why it stopped and how whales are protected.
heroAlt: A sperm whale resting at the surface off Madeira, its bushy blow slanting forward
keywords: when did whaling stop in madeira
